sys_script_client.description:
This script is created for MSSCUSTODY-2530
Code Description:
The Script include checkBandLimit() is called to evaluate if the assigned user holds the respective access groups and USD authorization limits to work on the task
1) If the Script Include returns 'True' no action is performed 2) If the script include returns 'False' the user is provided with a alert message and the "assiged to" field is cleared up
sys_script_client.name: Check Band Limit on Load of Assignee
